_doc: Art direction for tools/ds/site.mjs, keyed by lead slug. Data, not code: the lead-prep step (or a person looking at the photos) writes one entry per lead; a lead's own `art` object wins over this file. All photo numbers are 1-based (photo 1 = photos[0]). Keys: layout cinematic|field|arch|badge|pair (hero variant); hero = the hero photo (0 = no photo in the hero); focus = {n: 'x% y%'} object-position; text = photos with baked-in text, logos or graphics (never full-bleed behind the name; fine in a frame); skip = never shown (e.g. a flyer whose wording conflicts with the promo); posts = show as framed Instagram posts (flyers); pairs = stacked before/after composites (top = before), split at build time; wide = show landscape in the gallery; field = hex for the hero colour field; display/body = font keys from site.mjs DISPLAY/BODY; mark / mark2 = hex for the name lines; btn = hex for the hero button on the field; motif = divider key from site.mjs MOTIFS; ringText = words for the circular logo ring.
